description:
The HP Omen Max 45L is here, and it is a monster. Taking a slight detour from the usual custom Small Form Factor builds to test out one of the most powerful pre-built gaming PCs on the market right now. 

Big thanks to HyperX for sponsoring this video! Check out the HP Omen Max 45L here:
* PC: https://omen.fyi/OMENMAX45L
* Monitor: https://hyperx.gg/HX27q
* Keyboard: https://hyperx.gg/HXO2

Packed with the brand new AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D and an NVIDIA RTX 5080, this massive rig handles 4K gaming like an absolute champion. We’re tearing off the side panel to check out the unique 360mm AIO "Cryo Chamber" cooling design, tweaking the performance in the OMEN Gaming Hub, and putting it through a gauntlet of 4K gaming benchmarks including Cyberpunk 2077 with RT Overdrive, Red Dead Redemption 2, and Forza Horizon 5!
